flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Chemicals is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.76) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.point: ROE runs well ahead of the sector median.
Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Chemicals is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
P/B is expensive against the sector median.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -9.05 pp

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: The company aims to scale its manufacturing contribution to 50% of turnover over the next two to three years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects the company to maintain its five-year growth momentum over the next two years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, CAPEX I have answered and in terms of the foresee growth in the next two years, I think we are going to maintain the momentum which we have maintained in last five years." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The planned Rs. 20 crore CAPEX is specifically intended for developing polymer segment additives and compounding facilities.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "It is for polymer additives. The food we have already set up a plant for. This is going to be specifically in polymer segment where we are developing additives and compounding facility." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company acquired a 9.6-acre land parcel to establish its polymer additives and compounding facility.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Raw material demand picked up significantly from December onwards, driving up raw material prices in February.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: SK Minerals & Additives is initially focusing its flame-retardant products on cable and wire, as well as electrical and electronics equipment industries.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sales volumes increased to 46,000 metric tons in FY26 from 33,000 metric tons in FY25.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So, the volume was 33,000 metric ton in FY25 and this year it was 46,000 metric ton in 2026, which comprises of 4,400 metric ton of manufacturing capabilities." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company holds an order book of approximately Rs. 55 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company intends to file three patents over the next six months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "But in next six months, we will try to file three patents." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management plans to resolve teething issues at the polymer additives facility in three months and reach full utilization within six months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company's working capital cycle is currently at 110 days.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Currently, working capital cycle is of 110 days. We are trying to reduce this working capital cycle because it will improve in cash flow also in the organization." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.85 pp, DII -7.2 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Geopolitical disruptions have impacted import trading inventory by depleting the company's typical three-month raw material stock.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us. So, that stock is getting dried up." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The newly commissioned 400 metric ton per month polymer additives plant experienced initial teething issues.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S6/W12/O27/T8), led by 'The company aims to scale its manufacturing contribution to 50% of turnover over the next two to three years', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
